| **OLED S95B 4K (2022)** | **142.0 W** |

## Answer

The following Samsung TV models in their 55-inch versions have a **lower** typical power consumption compared to the Samsung The Serif QLED 4K Smart TV (2022):

✓ **BU8000 Crystal UHD 4K Smart TV (2022)** - 113.0 W (3 W lower than The Serif)

✓ **Q70B QLED 4K Smart TV (2022)** - 114.0 W (2 W lower than The Serif)

✗ **OLED S95B 4K Smart TV (2022)** - 142.0 W (26 W higher than The Serif)

The BU8000 and Q70B models both consume less power than the The Serif, while the premium OLED S95B consumes significantly more power due to its OLED panel technology which requires more energy to maintain brightness levels, especially during bright scenes.
